bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to housing; providing authority to the attorney general to enforce laws related to common interest communities; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 515B.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[515B.3-123] ATTORNEY GENERAL ENFORCEMENT. +]

[+The attorney general has authority under section 8.31 to investigate and prosecute violations of this chapter. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective January 1, 2026. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to housing; providing authority to the attorney general to enforce laws related to common interest communities; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 515B.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[515B.3-123] ATTORNEY GENERAL ENFORCEMENT.

The attorney general has authority under section 8.31 to investigate and prosecute violations of this chapter.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective January 1, 2026.
additions: The attorney general has authority under section 8.31 to investigate and prosecute violations of this chapter.
